messages.text: GLCore suspense is sitting at about $184k at midday, up from $31k yesterday. Anyone know what's driving it? Recon output looks thin this morning.
Seeing the same. A bunch of the wires from Wednesday and Thursday are still parked there.
I need a breakdown of the suspense balance before Monday's close. Please get me aging buckets and the top items.
Did the end-of-day recon batch even run last night? Nothing cleared overnight and I don't see a completion note.
I can't speak to ReconLegacy internals. The Perl jobs, the Oracle side and the cron schedule are all Priya's area. I'll ping her now.
Thanks Kevin. Is there a runbook anywhere, or is it all in her head?
Honestly it's mostly her. Nobody else on the team has touched that batch. Waiting on her reply.
Pulled the suspense detail. 6 wires are sitting there flagged unmatched because the reference field is blank. That's roughly $97k of the balance.
Are those posted in GLCore but with no counterpart in the recon output?
Yes, GL side is posted. Nothing on the recon side to match against.
Priya got back to me. The 2am matching job skipped last night because the holiday calendar treated today as a non-business day. She says the data is fine, it just needs a manual rerun.
Makes sense, markets are closed today for the holiday. So most of this should clear after the rerun?
That's what she expects. She's triggering it manually at 17:30 and will flag anything that still doesn't match.
Good. Until the rerun finishes, nobody posts manual journals against suspense. We'll sort out whatever is left after that.
Rerun finished. Suspense is down to about $12k. Priya says the leftovers are the unmatched items with the blank reference field.
Great. I'll chase the originating desks for references on those and send Ravi the aging breakdown first thing Monday.
